name: EntityIdentity
description: Present a host-defined entity with its glyph or avatar, readable name and supporting metadata.

props.name: actions
props.description: The entity's actions (R12): ActionBar in the header, ⋯ in compact and row, right-click everywhere.

props.name: count
props.description: Item count shown by the component.

props.name: facts
props.description: Data only (R2.2): model · firmware · IP. An array joins with " · ".

props.name: fill
props.description: `auto` only: the identity fills a box with a definite height, so height takes part.

props.name: heading
props.description: Header and compact title element. Default: h1 for the header, h2 for compact.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the identity opens. Click and Enter follow it; `onOpen` intercepts plain clicks.

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph (an icon without a size). Rows and chips always draw the glyph.

props.name: image
props.description: An illustration or image (``) for the header, compact and icon tiers.

props.name: kind
props.description: Singular noun for accessible names: "Printer" → "Printer HP-LJ-M480, Printing".

props.name: maxActions
props.description: Most header buttons (ActionBar maxButtons).

props.name: metric
props.description: One live value for the header (a Metric). Its box is reserved, so updates never shift.

props.name: name
props.description: The entity's name: accessible names, tooltips, menus ("Actions for NST-C106").

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called with no arguments when the person opens the identity. With `href`, it intercepts plain left clicks (modified clicks follow the link); without it, the title or row becomes a button.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Chip only: a removable chip (composer context) with no link.

props.name: portrait
props.description: A person in the icon slot at every tier, with the glyph as a corner mark. Beats `image`.

props.name: preview
props.description: Chip only: open the preview card on hover and focus (default true).

props.name: secondary
props.description: A row's second line. Defaults to the facts.

props.name: size
props.description: Chip only: inline sits in a prose line box (20px), sm suits rows and the composer (24px).

props.name: slots
props.description: Overrides for named content slots.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled view state, including loading, empty and error states.

props.name: tabs
props.description: L2 tabs, header only.

props.name: target
props.description: The entity the actions run against.

props.name: tier
props.description: A tier, or `auto` (default) to let the container decide on both axes (see tier.ts).

props.name: title
props.description: Rendered instead of the name (search highlights). The name stays the accessible text.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.
